the joint management of communication and computation resources in a general multi-user cloud computing system with computing access points.
the problem of joint computation offloading and resource management in mobile cloud systems.
the joint optimization of computation and communication resource allocation in mobile cloud computing with a computing access node.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, we propose an efficient three step joint offloading and resource optimization scheme to reduce the energy consumption, delay, and cost in the mobile cloud computing systems.
we propose a novel framework of joint offloading and resource management in mobile cloud computing system.

we propose an efficient three step algorithm for the joint management of communication and computation resources in mobile cloud systems with computing access point, where each user may have multiple independent tasks that can be processed locally, in the cloud, or in the access point.
The main takeaway from our work is that

, by jointly optimizing the computation and communication resources at a CAP, we can achieve significant gains in the overall system performance, compared to the case of purely local processing and purely cloud processing.
, in a mobile cloud computing system, a computing access point can significantly improve the overall cost performance by providing a computation service to the mobile users.
, in addition to providing network access, a CAP can be used as a computation offloading platform to improve system efficiency and user experience.
